get.description: Retrieves the details of an organization from the help desk.

parameters.name: includeCustomDomain
parameters.description:
Indicates whether the customDomain field must be included in the response

Possible values: - true = includes the customDomain field in the response - false = excludes the customDomain field from the response

patch.description: Updates the details of an organization.

get.description: Retrieves the favicon set for an organization/portal in the help desk.

parameters.name: no-cache
parameters.description:
Key that helps avoid browser cache

Note: Only alphanumeric values are allowed

parameters.name: fileSize
parameters.description:
Size of the image file to download

Possible values: THUMBNAIL, ACTUAL

Note: - THUMBNAIL = image with reduced dimensions and size - ACTUAL = image with actual dimensions and size

post.description: Updates the favicon set for an organization/portal in the help desk.

delete.description: Deletes the favicon set for an organization/portal in the help desk.
